title: Iron Arms & Back
description: Upper body push-pull strength with archer push-ups, pike push-ups and floor face pulls

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Plank to downward dog
exercises.instructions: Alternate between high plank and downward dog position

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.instructions: One arm extended to the side, lower toward the other hand

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower your head between your hands

exercises.name: Alternating superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm and left leg, alternate

exercises.name: Face pulls on the floor
exercises.instructions: Face down, elbows at 90 degrees, pull back

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift your chest off the floor, squeeze your shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind your head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
